evidenceAssessment.notice: Incomplete event leader sets. Displayed ages are observed boundaries only; uncovered Grand Prix events can change the oldest, youngest and national records. Missing leadership is unknown, not zero.
evidenceAssessment.missingEvidence: Complete event-level sets of drivers leading counted completed laps, or complete per-driver laps-led totals, for every excluded event, with canonical driver identities and event dates.

coverage.note: Ages use the separately accepted 784-driver birthdate evidence set. Drivers outside it remain unresolved, not age zero. Championship ages use the first F1DB clinching flag bound to the verified season champion. Race-leading ages require at least one counted completed lap led. Complete event-level driver laps-led totals supplement published lap charts for membership and event date only. Any uncovered event remains explicitly unresolved; lap-order metrics retain separate coverage.
